title: Refinement-based Flow Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.15123v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow-based policies offer an expressive representation for online reinforcement learning, but conventional flow matching requires samples drawn from the distribution to be modeled. This poses a challenge when the desired action distribution is defined only implicitly by a Q-function, since directly sampling actions from the resulting distribution is generally intractable. We propose Refinement-Based Flow Policy Optimization (RFPO), a novel framework for training a flow policy in online reinforcement learning by alternating between Q-guided sample refinement and self-target flow matching. RFPO first generates actions from Gaussian noise using the current flow policy and then uses a finite-step stochastic refinement procedure to move them toward an energy-based distribution induced by the Q-function. Each refined action is then paired with its corresponding initial noise sample and used as a fixed target for flow-matching training. By re

translated_title: 基于精炼的流策略优化
translated_abstract: 基于流的策略为在线强化学习提供了一种富有表现力的表示方法，但传统的流匹配需要从待建模的分布中抽取样本。当期望的动作分布仅由Q函数隐式定义时，这带来了挑战，因为直接从所得分布中采样动作通常是不可行的。我们提出了基于精炼的流策略优化（RFPO），这是一种在在线强化学习中训练流策略的新框架，通过交替进行Q引导的样本精炼和自目标流匹配来实现。RFPO首先使用当前流策略从高斯噪声生成动作，然后使用有限步随机精炼过程将这些动作向由Q函数诱导的基于能量的分布移动。随后，每个精炼后的动作与其对应的初始噪声样本配对，并用作流匹配训练的固定目标。
tldr: 提出RFPO框架，通过交替进行Q引导的样本精炼与自目标流匹配，解决了在线强化学习中动作分布仅由Q函数隐式定义而难以直接采样的难题。
en_tdlr: RFPO alternates between Q-guided sample refinement and self-target flow matching to train flow policies in online reinforcement learning, overcoming the intractability of sampling from action distributions that are only implicitly defined by a Q-function.
